en.title: House Democrats nominate Hakeem Jeffries for speaker
en.dek: Democrats selected Jeffries as their candidate during a closed-door caucus on Wednesday.
facts: House Democrats nominated Representative Hakeem Jeffries of New York for speaker of the House during a closed-door caucus meeting on Wednesday.
Jeffries secured 251 votes in the secret ballot during the Democratic caucus.
The nomination marks Jeffries as the Democratic candidate for speaker in the upcoming Congress.
Jeffries is the first Black person to lead a major party's speaker nomination process in the House.
The closed-door meeting was held to select the Democratic leader ahead of the new congressional term.
Multiple outlets confirmed Jeffries secured 251 votes in the secret ballot.
body: House Democrats nominated Representative Hakeem Jeffries of New York for speaker of the House during a closed-door caucus meeting on Wednesday.
According to multiple reports, Jeffries secured 251 votes in the secret ballot, moving him closer to potentially becoming the first Black US House speaker.
The nomination occurred during a closed-door caucus meeting where Democrats selected their candidate for the speaker position.
Jeffries, who has led the Democratic caucus since 2019, faced no serious opposition for the nomination within the party.
The vote count of 251 reflects the size of the Democratic caucus in the upcoming Congress, though the final speaker election will occur when the full House convenes.
Multiple news outlets including Euronews, Channel News Asia, The Hill, and Axios confirmed the nomination and vote count.
en.context: House Democratic leadership elections are held periodically to select the party's candidate for speaker ahead of a new congressional term. The process involves a closed-door caucus meeting where party members vote to determine their nominee.
